description: One source store or system mirrored into this site, one way and idempotently: what is new at the source is created, what changed is updated, what was deleted is retired, and what didn't change isn't touched.

fields.label: Connection ID
fields.description: A short, permanent id (lowercase letters, digits and dashes), e.g. omg-woo. It is part of every identity this connection mints, so it can never change.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Run on the schedule (hourly incremental, daily full). A disabled connection can still be run by hand.

fields.label: Store URL
fields.description: WooCommerce: the site's https:// address. Shopify: the store's <name>.myshopify.com domain.

fields.label: Credentials
fields.options:
Application Password
Consumer Key
Client Credentials
Access Token
fields.description: WooCommerce: an Application Password (Users → Profile) reads everything, drafts and redirects included; a REST API consumer key (WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced) reads the store, and published WordPress content only. Shopify: Client Credentials for an app made in the Dev Dashboard (the importer exchanges them for a 24-hour token and renews it); Access Token for a legacy custom app made in the store admin before 2026.

fields.label: User, Key or Client ID
fields.description: WooCommerce: the WordPress user name, or the consumer key. Shopify: the app's client ID.

fields.label: Secret
fields.description: The Application Password, consumer secret, Shopify client secret or legacy Admin API access token. Never shown again or logged.

fields.label: Public Site
fields.description: The site these records belong to: its company keeps the books, its route prefix holds the pages, and its webshop store sells the items.

fields.label: Abbreviation
fields.description: Suffix and prefix for records ERPNext names globally (item codes, item groups, blog categories, coupon names), so two connections never collide, e.g. OMG.

fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Parent of the mirrored categories, and the group of items that have none.

fields.label: Price List
fields.description: Selling price list that holds the mirrored prices; its currency must be the source's.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse whose stock mirrors the source's stock levels.

fields.label: Guest Customer
fields.description: Customer of orders placed without an account.

fields.label: Fallback Item
fields.description: A non-stock item for order lines whose product no longer exists at the source, and for refunded amounts beyond the refunded lines.

fields.label: Deposit Account
fields.description: Where the source's payments land (and refunds leave), e.g. a payment-processor clearing account.

fields.label: Fee Account
fields.description: Order fees and tips. Orders with fees are not mirrored without one.

fields.label: Products → Items, prices, stock, Website Items
Orders → Sales Invoices, Payment Entries, credit notes
Filters
fields.description: Per-kind source filters, e.g. {"product": "status:active"} (Shopify search syntax). A filtered kind never retires anything.

fields.label: Credential Hold
fields.description: Set when the source rejected the credentials: scheduled runs are held until this connection is saved or a run is started by hand.

name: Importer Connection
